tasks.title: CTX API MCP migration: base setup
tasks.description: Initialize migration work to comptox.epa.gov/ctx-api and prepare MCP integration for agents.
tasks.details:
- Add env vars: CTX_API_BASE_URL, CTX_API_KEY, CTX_USE_LEGACY
- Draft plan for endpoint coverage and testing
- Set default base URL to new server

tasks.title: Audit current MCP + CTX endpoints
tasks.description: Inventory existing MCP tools and which CTX endpoints they call, current base URL(s), auth method, and error handling.
tasks.details:
- Identify all MCP tools for CTX: names, input schema, output schema
- Map each tool to current CTX endpoint(s) and HTTP methods
- Document base URL(s) used and any versioning in paths
- Note current auth header usage and rate-limit handling
- Output findings to docs/mcp_ctx_audit.md

tasks.title: Configure base URL + legacy fallback
tasks.description: Add env-configurable base URL defaulting to https://comptox.epa.gov/ctx-api and optional legacy fallback to https://api-ccte.epa.gov until 2025-10-01.
tasks.details:
- Add `CTX_API_BASE_URL` env var (default to new server)
- Add `CTX_USE_LEGACY` or allow override of base via env
- Implement quick health/check call to validate connectivity
- Keep fallback documented as temporary with deprecation date

tasks.title: Implement API key authentication
tasks.description: Confirm required auth header with new CTX APIs and wire API key from env.
tasks.details:
- Confirm header name (likely `x-api-key`) from docs
- Read from `CTX_API_KEY` env; never hardcode
- Add informative error when key missing for live calls
- Update local setup instructions

tasks.title: Update MCP tools for CTX endpoints
tasks.description: Update existing MCP tools to new paths/versions and add coverage for key CTX categories.
tasks.details:
- Verify and adjust paths for existing tools against comptox.epa.gov/ctx-api
- Add/confirm tools for: chemical search, hazard, bioactivity, exposure
- Ensure input/output schemas are stable and documented
- Validate responses and normalize fields where needed

tasks.title: Add robust error handling + retries
tasks.description: Improve reliability against rate limits and transient failures.
tasks.details:
- Implement exponential backoff on 429/5xx with jitter
- Surface actionable error messages with context
- Capture and log rate-limit headers/request IDs when present
- Add timeout and circuit-breaker defaults if needed

tasks.title: Add tests + smoke script
tasks.description: Ensure MCP works end-to-end against the new CTX server with a valid API key.
tasks.details:
- Unit tests for request builder, auth header, error handling
- Integration smoke tests gated by `CTX_API_KEY`
- Add `scripts/smoke_ctx.sh` to hit 1–2 endpoints and report status

tasks.title: Update docs + examples
tasks.description: Document new base URL, authentication, migration notes, and provide usage examples.
tasks.details:
- Update docs/api_reference.md with new base URL, sample requests, env vars
- Add migration notes and deprecation date for legacy server
- Provide `.env.example` placeholders and quickstart for agents

tasks.title: Epic: Migrate MCP to new CTX API server
tasks.description: Track the overall migration, from endpoint updates through testing and docs, defaulting to comptox.epa.gov/ctx-api.
tasks.details: Subtasks: Audit MCP endpoints; Configure base URL + fallback; Implement API key auth; Update MCP tools; Add error handling + retries; Add tests + smoke script; Update docs + examples
